what: P1-FL06 (R128): the assists carry the stability on the arcade handling. The same over-driven driving at each level: Lots stays on the road, Some damps the slide, Off spins. (1) The greybox loop's first bend, the hairpin, taken flat out: a lift and a stab with full lock toward the line at the bend; the hairpin exits 117 m from the start line. (2) The Tradie Ute's power slide: a throttle punch at full lock from 6 m/s, held. Envelopes are what crates/jj-sim/tests/assist.rs asserts; the measured numbers are in docs/evidence/P1-FL06/.
